# Wiggle Your Tail Pet Care

> Professional pet care services in Sarasota, FL — dog walking, pet sitting, overnight care, snowbird services, and wedding pet attendants. Insured, bonded, and locally owned by Christa.

## Services

- [Dog Walking](https://wiggleyourtail.com/wiggleyourtail-dog-walking/): Daily dog walking services in Sarasota — solo and small-group walks, GPS tracked, with photo updates.
- [Pet Sitting & Overnights](https://wiggleyourtail.com/drop-in-visits-overnight-dog-sitting/): Drop-in visits and overnight stays at your home so pets stay in their own environment.
- [Snowbird & House Sitting](https://wiggleyourtail.com/away-from-home-snowbird-services/): Full home and pet care for seasonal residents while away for extended periods.
- [Wedding Pet Attendant](https://wiggleyourtail.com/wedding-pet-attendant/): On-site handler to include your pet in your wedding day, then transport them safely home.
- [Services & Rates](https://wiggleyourtail.com/services-rates/): Full pricing and service tier overview.
